name: manual_c1c47a
claim: A TODO's non-essential acceptance criterion (e.g. a benchmark with no real workload to test against yet) should be explicitly deferred with a cross-repo doc link, not silently dropped or left as an unchecked box with no explanation

decisions.notes: PT's STM concurrency work (PR #205) satisfied 4/5 acceptance criteria for async-safe concurrency; the 5th (benchmark latency under high-peer-count) had no real caller/workload to benchmark against. Rather than leave it unchecked or quietly drop it, it was marked DONE-with-deferral and cross-linked to orama-system docs/v2/03-safety-v2.5.md (the v2.5 safety-overlay milestone doc), which is also where D23's single-operator-LAN premise check lives — the same premise check that may make the benchmark moot entirely. This keeps the plan's completion status honest and gives a future reader the exact doc where the deferred item will be picked back up.
